newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London see rally peter out.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London see rally peter out.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London saw a modest rise on Friday but traders said profit-taking had crept in to limit gains.
The Nikkei 50/lse share index in London was 3.67 points higher at 1,453.11 by 1548 GMT.
In Tokyo the key Nikkei-225 index closed some 33.94 points higher at 18,722.00, but traders said investors were looking to a wider range of blue-chips.
"We saw a little profit-taking in core blue chips such as Canon and Sharp," one trader said.
Sony continued to lead the index trading at 9,152.5 in London, up sharply from a Tokyo close of 9,080 yen.
"Sony was attracting interest because it's only 400 yen away from life-time highs of 9,500 yen, one trader said, "I'd expect to see Sony continue moving upwards next week."
However the broader market would come off a little, he added. "People got carried away and core issues got overheated. I'd expect them to settle on Monday."
